findings.description: The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Although S3 applies baseline SSE-S3 encryption by default for newly uploaded objects, this configuration does not enforce bucket-level encryption or a customer-managed KMS key as required for a controlled encryption-at-rest posture.

The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Versioning and access logging do not establish or enforce encryption for the stored artifacts; no bucket-level encryption or customer-managed KMS key is configured.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. This leaves no bucket-level configuration enforcing encryption settings or a customer-managed KMS key for runbook objects.
